app.name: Inventory
app.description: Track your belongings: what is where

items.title: My items
items.empty: Nothing here yet. Tap the camera below to add your first item.
items.tagsHint: Enter or comma adds a tag
items.deleteConfirm: The item and all its photos will be deleted. This cannot be undone.
items.photosLimit: Up to {max} photos, the first one is the main photo.
items.recognized: Filled in by AI — please check.
items.placeVoiceHint: Or say where you put it, details about the item welcome:

search.title: Search
search.hint: Type a word for a plain search, or tap the mic and ask: “where is my drill?”
search.nothing: Nothing found. Try “Ask AI”: it adds synonyms.
search.found: {count, plural, one {# item found} other {# items found}}

locations.title: Places
locations.empty: No places yet. Add a house, apartment or country house, then rooms, closets and shelves inside.
locations.itemsCount: {count, plural, =0 {no items} one {# item} other {# items}}
locations.deleteConfirm: The place will be deleted. This cannot be undone.
locations.deleteBlocked: Cannot delete: it contains {places, plural, =0 {} one {# place} other {# places}}{both, select, yes { and } other {}}{items, plural, =0 {} one {# item} other {# items}}. Move or delete them first.

signup.title: Sign up
signup.checkEmail: We sent an email to {email}. Open the link in it to confirm your address.

forgot.title: Reset password
forgot.intro: Enter your email and we will send you a link to set a new password.
forgot.sent: If an account with {email} exists, it will receive an email with a link. Open it in this same browser.

reset.title: New password
reset.intro: Choose a new password for signing in.

auth.linkError: The email link is invalid or has expired. Request a new one and open it in the same browser you used to request it.

errors.passwordTooShort: Password must be at least 8 characters
errors.passwordTooLong: Password is too long (72 characters max)
errors.emailNotConfirmed: Email is not confirmed. Open the link from the email.
errors.emailTaken: An account with this email already exists. Try signing in.
errors.weakPassword: Password is too weak. Choose another one.
errors.samePassword: New password is the same as the old one
errors.emailRateLimit: Too many emails. Try again later.
errors.rateLimit: Too many attempts. Wait a bit and try again.
errors.sessionExpired: Session expired. Request the link again.
errors.unknown: Something went wrong. Please try again.

auth.accountDeleted: Your account and all data have been deleted.

common.nameHint: You can fill in just one field: the other gets the same text, or use “Translate”.

errors.nameRequired: Enter a name in at least one language
errors.locationCycle: A place cannot be moved inside itself or one of its nested places
errors.locationNotEmpty: There are places or items inside. Move or delete them first.
errors.parentNotFound: The selected place was not found. Refresh the page.
errors.notFound: Not found. It may have been deleted already.
errors.aiLimit: Daily AI request limit reached. Try again later.
errors.aiBusy: AI is busy right now. Try again in a minute.
errors.aiProviderQuota: The Gemini key has used up its daily quota (free tier). Translation will work again after Google resets the quota, within about a day.
errors.aiFailed: AI could not answer. Please try again.
errors.unauthorized: Session expired. Please sign in again.
errors.network: No connection to the server. Check your internet.
errors.unknown: Something went wrong. Please try again.

errors.photoTooMany: No more than 10 photos per item
errors.photoInvalid: The photos could not be saved. Please try again.
errors.photoUnsupported: This image format is not supported. Try JPEG or PNG.
errors.photoUpload: Could not upload the photo. Check your internet and try again.
errors.micDenied: No access to the microphone. Allow it in the browser settings or type instead.
errors.micUnsupported: Voice recording is not available in this browser. Type instead.
errors.recordingTooShort: The recording is too short. Tap the mic, say the phrase, tap again.
errors.recordingFailed: Could not process the recording. Try again or type instead.
errors.aiNoPlace: Could not tell which place. Say it more precisely or pick from the list.
errors.aiNoTerms: Could not tell what to look for. Try saying it differently.

onboarding.placeIntro: Items live in places: a house, rooms, closets, shelves. Start with the main one — where are your things?
onboarding.hereIntro: With “I'm here”, new items go straight into this place. You can change it in the app header.
onboarding.howPhoto: Tap the camera below and take a photo of the item.
onboarding.howAi: AI suggests the name, description and category.
onboarding.howVoice: Say where you put it: “garage, on the rack” — the place is found or created.
onboarding.howSearch: Search by voice or text: “where is my drill?”

offline.title: No connection
offline.text: Your data lives on the server, so the app needs the internet. Check your connection and try again.
offline.banner: Offline. Saving and AI will work again when the connection is back.
